facts: Signed offline kit verification checks a separately trusted primary GPG fingerprint, complete file inventory, SHA-256/size, expected app version and minimum release sequence.
Launch copies and rehashes the AppImage into a private directory before direct FUSE or explicit extract/run.
Producer binds AppImage to the immutable A15 source and A17 overlay using a retained build record.
The frozen signature fixture is public synthetic data, not a compiled AppImage or installable kit.
Schema remains v6 and no application Rust/IPC/CSP/package-manager behavior is changed.
limitations: Actual AppImage build, real gpg-agent release signing, FUSE/extract/WebKitGTK runtime and distribution ABI acceptance remain host/release gates.
A17 does not implement the live ABL Nostr transport orchestration deferred by A10/A11.
